newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble edges up as Yeltsin surgery said successful.
newsitem.headline: Rouble edges up as Yeltsin surgery said successful.

text.p: The rouble edged up after news President Boris Yeltsin feels all right after successful heart surgery, dealers said.

"More people have appeared recently who are buying overnight rouble credits to take part in tomorrow's (government bond) auctions. They are also selling dollars to keep a long rouble position," Bank Menatep dealer Mikhail Zaretsky said.
On Wednesday, November 6, the central bank is auctioning eight trillion roubles of six-month paper and 2.5 trillion of an additional tranche of OFZ bonds.
An Interbank Finance House dealer said market speculators reacted quickly to the Yeltsin news and the rouble edged up from earlier levels but fluctuations were otherwise moderate.

Roubles for today settlement were quoted at 5,463-64 per dollar compared with an early 5,468-70 and 5,464-66 late on Monday. Tomorrow roubles edged up to 5,466-68 per dollar from an early 5,469-71. They were quoted at 5,463-65 late yesterday.
The central bank said it had set 5,449/5,473 as its bid and offer rates against the dollar on Tuesday.
Overnight rouble credits yielded 25-35 percent compared with Monday's late one to five percent.
